name: CopilotKit
title_zh: 给 Agent 套上能点能拖的前端皮肤
tagline_zh: React/Angular/移动端/Slack 全都要？一套组件让 AI 生成可交互界面，不用再为每个渠道重写 U。
tagline_en: React, Angular, mobile, Slack—one component kit for AI-generated interactive UIs, no more per-channel rewrites.
desc_en: The Frontend Stack for Agents & Generative UI. React, Angular, Mobile, Slack, and more.  Makers of the AG-UI Protocol
why_zh: 不只是聊天框——它把 AG-UI 协议变成现成组件，让 Agent 输出直接渲染成按钮、表单、图表。
why_en: Beyond chat—it turns the AG-UI protocol into ready-made components, rendering agent output as buttons, forms, and charts, making.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
